summary: Test a candidate agent version against the baseline on fixed cases before it ships: pass rate, cost and latency, regressions first.
intent: Block: offline regression testing of a candidate agent version against the baseline on a fixed set of cases. A Scoreboard of pass rate, average cost, p50 latency and regressions; a SegmentedControl (Regressions / Improvements / All) and FilterBar (tag, dataset) over a DataTable of cases; a case opens a Drawer with the input, both outputs as a split InlineDiff and the grader's note. Promote candidate is the one solid primary, disabled with a reason while regressions are unreviewed.
useWhen: a new prompt, model or tool change must not break cases that passed before
a person decides whether to promote a candidate agent version
each failing case needs both outputs side by side
doNotUseWhen: a live traffic split between variants — ExperimentCard
reviewing the files an agent changed — ChangeReview
one run's steps and metrics — RunDetail

baseline.note: { label, metrics: { passRate (0–1), avgCost, p50LatencyMs } }, e.g. label "v12".

candidate.note: Same shape as baseline, e.g. label "v13".

cases.note: { id, name, tags?, dataset?, input, baseline: { result: "pass" | "fail" | "error", output, score?, cost? }, candidate: same, graderNote?, accepted?, flagged? }[]. A regression passed in baseline and not in candidate; accepted or flagged counts it as reviewed.

view.note: Uncontrolled (starts on regressions) when omitted. Rows sort regressions, errors, improvements, rest.

onPromote.note: Promote <candidate>, the one solid primary; disabled with the reason beside it while running, after an error or while regressions are unreviewed.

onAcceptExpected.note: (id) => void from the case Drawer. Set accepted on the case.

onFlag.note: (id) => void from the case Drawer. Set flagged on the case.

status.note: running shows a Progress with "Running n of N cases"; error a danger Alert.

errorMessage.default: The run stopped before every case finished.

layout: header with the versions line, then the Scoreboard full width, the view and filters, the cases table and the Promote footer
the block is its own inline-size container and takes the full width; the DataTable scrolls sideways inside its frame on narrow screens

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
results are words in Badges (Pass / Fail / Error), never colour alone
each row has an Open button in a group named "Details for <case>", so rows are reached and opened from the keyboard
the case Drawer keeps focus and returns it to the Open button on close
Promote is disabled with its reason as text, linked with aria-describedby
running sets aria-busy and announces progress in a status region
the diff is InlineDiff split (Added / Removed for screen readers); no motion of its own

doNot: Do not invent a local EvalTable, RegressionList or VersionCompare
Do not let Promote run while regressions are unreviewed
Promote is the one solid primary; Re-run is outline
snippet: <EvalSuite baseline={{ label: "v12", metrics: v12 }} candidate={{ label: "v13", metrics: v13 }} cases={cases} onPromote={promote} onRerun={rerun} onAcceptExpected={accept} onFlag={flag} />
